dedupe_keys.name: establishments open to the public erp in grand paris sud est avenir 2022

description: Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir, a territorial authority of 16 communes in the Val-de-Marne south-east of Paris, publishes its census of all establishments receiving the public (ERP) on its territory for 2022, giving for each public facility its address, geographic coordinates, name, type and facility code. The dataset cites article R.123-2 of the French Construction and Housing Code, which defines ERP as all buildings, premises and enclosures to which people are admitted freely or for payment, or where meetings open to anyone are held, anyone other than staff being counted as public; the list therefore covers schools, sports halls, libraries, administrative offices and other equipment of the territory. Coverage: GPSEA communes. Access: free CSV on data.gouv.fr (created November 2022, updated January 2024, annual frequency). Licence: Licence Ouverte. Caveats: a local authority list whose scope may be limited to public equipment, not every private ERP. Simulation uses: locating public buildings for flood exposure, heat refuges and emergency planning in the Paris region. Related records: the Seine-et-Marne ERP layer.
